map.nothing.title: No place found
map.nothing.nodes: None of the {total} nodes has a point or two numbers for latitude and longitude.
map.nothing.rows: None of the {total} rows has coordinates, a geohash or a code Kalzit knows.
map.nothing.editor: Choose the place in the panel editor.
map.codes.title: Codes not found: {count}
map.status.countriesFailed: the country areas could not be loaded
map.view.label: View
map.table.name: Name
map.canvas.label: Map: {title}
map.cluster.label: {count} places, a click zooms in
map.missing.title: {count} rows without a place
map.missing.more: and {count} more; the table view shows all of them
map.editor.layersHint: The top layer lies in front. Each layer draws the places in its own way.
map.editor.layersFull: A map has at most four layers.
map.editor.kindPointsHint: For places with a value. Near points are bundled.
map.editor.kindAreasHint: Fills countries by their code (ISO 3166, two or three letters).
map.editor.placeHint: Auto finds fields named lat/lon or latitude/longitude, a point or GeoJSON, a geohash or a country code.
map.editor.latLonHint: Decimal degrees, WGS 84. Empty: names such as lat and lon are found.
map.editor.pointFieldHint: A point or GeoJSON point in one field. Empty: found by name.
map.editor.geohashHint: One text field; the point stands in the middle of the cell.
map.editor.keyHint: ISO 3166 code with two or three letters. Empty: found by name.
map.editor.valuePointHint: A number field sets the size and the colour scale. Empty: all alike.
map.editor.valueAreaHint: The number that colours each country; several rows of one country are added up.
map.editor.colorHint: Thresholds use the panel’s thresholds; the legend shows the steps.
map.editor.caption: Caption
map.editor.captionHint: Empty: name, title or the id.
map.editor.outlinesHint: Shipped with Kalzit. No network needed.
map.editor.imagesOff: The map draws the bundled outlines and a graticule; no request leaves your server.
map.editor.clusterHint: 0 never clusters. A click on a cluster zooms in.
map.editor.edgesHint: Edges between clusters are merged and drawn wider.
map.codes.full: {count} more do not fit: a layer keeps at most {max} code pairs.
map.table.cut: The first {shown} of {total} rows; the rest are on the map and in a table panel.
map.tiles.failedTitle: The map images are not loading right now.
map.tiles.failedText: The map shows outlines; your data is complete. This is not an error of the panel. Admins see the reason under Administration > Map.
map.admin.imagesOff: Off: maps show coordinates with outlines. Kalzit asks no map service.
map.admin.imagesOn: On: the Kalzit server fetches the map images from the source below and keeps them in its cache.
map.admin.outlinesText: Countries and regions, shipped with Kalzit. No network needed.
map.admin.whyOff: Map images come from a service outside your server. Only when you enter a source does the Kalzit server fetch them; the browsers of viewers still talk only to Kalzit.
map.admin.urlHint: With the placeholders {z}, {x} and {y}, and {key} for the access key. Only https.
map.admin.attributionHint: Required. Shown on every map and in every export.
map.admin.maxZoomHint: 0 to 22. Kalzit asks for no image above it.
map.admin.keyHint: Fills {key} in the address. Stored encrypted, never shown in the browser.
map.admin.keyStored: Stored. Type a new one to replace it; it stays while the address keeps its host.
map.admin.cacheSizeHint: 16 to 102400. The oldest images go first.
map.admin.cacheDaysHint: 1 to 365. After that, an image is fetched again.
map.admin.proxyNone: None is set; the server fetches the map images directly.
map.admin.proxyUsed: Map images use the proxy from Administration > Network, HTTPS and proxy ({proxy}).
map.admin.testedProxy: Map image {tile} loaded: {size}, {type}, {ms} ms, through the proxy.
map.admin.checkField: Check the marked field. Nothing was saved.
map.admin.saveTests: Saving loads one map image first and saves only when that works.
map.admin.switchedOff: Map images are off. Maps show outlines.
map.admin.conflict: Someone else changed this setting. The page shows the current state now.
map.admin.way.title: Way of a map image
map.admin.way.text: Fetching needs a sign-in or a working share link, like the panel itself. The content security policy stays at “this server only”. Kalzit checks z, x and y against the highest zoom level and the valid ranges and limits fetches per person or share link.
map.reason.map.url_invalid: Enter the address of the map images, up to {maxChars} characters.
map.reason.map.url_placeholders: The address needs {z}, {x} and {y}; {key} is the only other placeholder.
map.reason.map.url_not_https: The address must start with https://. Plain http only works for this computer.
map.reason.map.url_credentials: No user, password or # part in the address. Use {key} and the access key.
map.reason.map.url_kalzit: The address points at this Kalzit server.
map.reason.map.attribution_required: Without an attribution, Kalzit must not show the map images.
map.reason.map.attribution_invalid: The attribution is at most {maxChars} characters on one line.
map.reason.map.max_zoom_invalid: The highest zoom level is a whole number from 0 to {max}.
map.reason.map.cache_size_invalid: The cache size is a whole number from {min} to {max} MB.
map.reason.map.cache_ttl_invalid: The cache duration is a whole number from {min} to {max} days.
map.reason.map.key_invalid: The access key is at most {maxChars} characters on one line.
map.reason.map.key_required: The address has {key}. Enter the access key for this map service.
map.reason.map.key_unused: The address has no {key}, so the access key would not be used.
map.reason.map.source_failed: The source of the map images cannot be reached.
map.reason.map.source_timeout: The source of the map images did not answer in time.
map.reason.map.source_denied: The source answered {status} (access denied). Check the access key.
map.reason.map.source_status: The source answered {status}. Check the address.
map.reason.map.not_an_image: The source answered with something that is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
map.reason.map.tile_too_large: The source answered with an image larger than {maxBytes} bytes.
map.reason.map.tiles_unavailable: The map images cannot be loaded right now.
map.reason.map.not_configured: No source of map images is set up yet.
